A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MLMC-NAC work. The main text, algorithm, theoretical comparison table, equations, and Appendices A–H are available for comparison despite the changed title and formatting.

before.justification: v2 reports theoretical convergence guarantees and proofs. Table 1 summarizes theoretical literature; neither the main text nor appendices report original empirical outcomes.

after.justification: v3 remains a theoretical paper. Its main text and Appendices A–H contain no original experimental, simulation, user-study, or data-analysis results.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 replaces max{2^Q, Tmax} trajectory lengths in both subroutines with 2^Q when it does not exceed Tmax, and zero otherwise. This is a localized sampling-procedure revision; the critic updates, NPG updates, and MLMC estimator formulas remain unchanged. Obtaining the base estimates U0 and V0 in the zero-length case remains unclear.

E1.justification: Neither version trains or evaluates on datasets or concrete test environments. The stronger emphasis on infinite state/action spaces concerns theoretical applicability, not added evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Neither version experimentally evaluates comparison methods. Table 1 changes its selection of published theoretical guarantees, which affects research positioning rather than an evaluated baseline set.

E3.justification: Neither version contains experimental evaluation protocols. The theoretical choices of H, K, Tmax, and learning rates are retained; Algorithm 1's sampling-rule revision is assessed under M1.

E4.justification: Neither version contains ablations, robustness experiments, sensitivity studies, error analyses, or case studies. Appendices A–H retain the same theoretical proof sequence.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated experimental runs, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The retained bias and variance bounds are theoretical analyses.

E6.justification: No empirical result entries are added, removed, or revised. The work's principal convergence guarantee remains an approximation-error term plus a logarithmic-factor-suppressed O(tmix^3/sqrt(T)) term. Changes to theoretical statements and literature summaries are assessed under T1 and R1.

T1.justification: Definition 1 now specifies total variation distance and explicitly assumes finite uniform mixing time, replacing v2's assertion that finiteness follows from ergodicity. Most mathematics and all appendix proofs are retained. Theorem 3's reformatted bound omits an addition sign between two order terms, although Appendix F retains their additive form.

C1.justification: The order-optimal rate and independence from mixing-time knowledge remain central claims. v3 refines the improvement-over-prior-work framing around actor–critic methods, acknowledging an order-optimal direct-PG result and emphasizing sharper bias analysis. State/action-size independence was already claimed in v2.

C2.justification: v3 adds substantive explanations of the TD critic's variance-reduction versus additional-bias tradeoff, and of exponential bias decay under i.i.d. noise versus potentially persistent Markovian bias. It also qualifies the comparison with Wang et al. through minimum versus average error and discusses possible application to discounted MDPs.

D1.justification: The learning-rate formulas, initialization choices, and theoretical loop budgets remain documented at the same level. Beyond the procedural revision assessed under M1, no implementation settings, hardware information, or code/data access information are added.

R1.justification: v3 substantially revises positioning around direct PG versus actor–critic analysis. It adds PHPG from Ganesh et al. (2024) and the Markovian-bias discussion citing Nagaraj et al. (2020). Table 1 removes FOPO, OLSVI.FH, and MDP-EXP2 and adds PHPG, scalability distinctions, and qualifications about prior guarantees. Giles (2015) and Wei et al. (2021) are removed from the references.

P1.justification: The paper is retitled, and the abstract, introductory motivation, contribution list, and related-work narrative are substantially rewritten. Related work changes from three topic groups to two, and an Impact Statement is added. The later technical sections and appendix organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: The single-column manuscript becomes an ICML-style two-column main text and bibliography, with extensive equation reflow and new running headers. Algorithm 1 moves into a column. Table 1 gains an infinite-state/action column, revised rows, and explanatory footnotes. The appendices remain single-column but are repaginated.

improvement.justification: v3 improves precision by explicitly assuming finite mixing time and explaining the contribution relative to order-optimal direct PG and earlier actor–critic analyses. These are useful but limited gains because the principal theorem and appendix proofs remain unchanged. The missing addition sign in Theorem 3 and unclear base sampling in Algorithm 1 temper the improvement; Appendix F preserves the intended additive bound.
